ruleDefinitions.name: Amsi.DLL Loaded Via LOLBIN Process
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects loading of "Amsi.dll" by a living of the land process. This could be an indication of a "PowerShell without PowerShell" attack Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: (ImageLoaded = RGX("\\\\amsi\\\.dll$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\ExtExport\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\odbcconf\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\regsvr32\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\rundll32\\\.exe$")))
